before.label: before
before.scope: Actual ConversationEngine and WorkspaceVault filesystem completion of four concurrently released responses over the same twenty-large-Unicode-message fixture. Both sides retain all four exact owners/replies and all twenty large messages; the batched side preserves the exact complete pre-final workspace as backup. Measured local Node process elapsed time includes persistence and state notifications; resource samples are before/after, not peaks or remote deadline samples. This does not establish the precise hosted queue/clone/IPC timeout contributions.

scope: Actual local ConversationEngine and WorkspaceVault completion of four simultaneous replies over the same 84,014,340-byte Unicode workspace. Exact reply owners/content/status and all twenty large messages survive both implementations. The new batch also retains the complete pre-final file as the atomic backup. Before/after memory is sampled, not peak usage. This local comparison does not establish the precise hosted timeout phase or prove the next hosted run.
